content: A series of controls are implemented to prevent models from picking up on trivial correlations. To prevent models from capturing topic-specific information (e.g., political conversations are more likely to derail), each attack-containing conversation is paired with a clean conversation from the same talk page, where the talk page serves as a proxy for topic. To force models to actually capture conversational dynamics rather than detecting already-existing toxicity, human annotations are used to ensure that all comments preceding a personal attack are civil.
